name: GlobalLogic Inc.
overview_text: GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a global leader in digital product engineering. It builds intelligent products, platforms, and services at the intersection of design, data, and engineering helping Fortune 500 clients across industries accelerate digital transformation through AI-powered solutions, experience design, software engineering, and technology modernization. Operates with a 'zero-distance' global delivery model across 60+ product engineering centers.
